ObjectStates.Name: Digital_Clock
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
--[[ Turn timer scripted by Skor. Timer starts counting down on turn start. --]]

time = 120
teleport = false --[[ Set to true if you want the timer to teleport in front of each player's hand.
                                The change will not take effect on the clock that already exists, but you can copy/paste
                                a new one, or save to chest and load the saved one, and the change will effect the new clock. --]]
teleportdistance = 3 -- If the above is true, this controls how far in front of the player's hand the clock teleports to.

function onload()
    local button = {}
    button.label = math.floor(time/60)..':'..string.format('%02d', time%60)
    button.height = 75
    button.width = 150
    button.font_size = 50
    button.position = {0, 0.38, 0}
    button.rotation = {0, 180, 0}
    button.click_function = 'startClock'
    button.function_owner = self
    button.color = "Red"
--button.tooltip = "This timer will automatically start counting down at the beginning of each player's turn.\n\nHowever, you can also start and reset it manually by clicking this red button.\n\nThe numbers in this button will not change. Look at the display to see the actual countdown."
    button.tooltip = "倒计时器功能：\n\n     回合轮转时启动倒计时\n（仅在设置turn后才能生效）\n\n你也可以按下中间红色的按钮来重新开始倒计时\n\n*默认倒计时为2min,可使用按钮使倒计时增、减1/10s。\n*当脚本中teleport为true，该计时器会在玩家面前轮流传递。\n*修改自Skor的Simple Trun Timer"
    self.createButton(button)

    button.label = '«'
    button.width = 50
    button.height = 50
    button.click_function = 'dec10'
    button.position = {0.285, 0.38, 0}
    button.color = "White"
    self.createButton(button)

    button.label = '‹'
    button.width = 50
    button.height = 50
    button.click_function = 'dec1'
    button.position = {0.19, 0.38, 0}
    button.color = "White"
    self.createButton(button)

    button.label = '›'
    button.width = 50
    button.height = 50
    button.click_function = 'inc1'
    button.position = {-0.19, 0.38, 0}
    button.color = "White"
    self.createButton(button)

    button.label = '»'
    button.width = 50
    button.height = 50
    button.click_function = 'inc10'
    button.position = {-0.285, 0.38, 0}
    button.color = "White"
    self.createButton(button)
end

function onPlayerTurnStart(pl, prevpl)

    runClock()

    if teleport then
        self.setPosition({Player[pl].getPlayerHand().pos_x + (Player[pl].getPlayerHand().trigger_forward_x * teleportdistance), Player[pl].getPlayerHand().trigger_up_y, Player[pl].getPlayerHand().pos_z + (Player[pl].getPlayerHand().trigger_forward_z * teleportdistance)})
        self.setRotation({Player[pl].getPlayerHand().rot_x, Player[pl].getPlayerHand().rot_y, Player[pl].getPlayerHand().rot_z})
    end
end

function startClock()
  runClock()
end

function runClock()
  self.Clock.setValue(time + 1)
  self.Clock.pauseStart()

  -- Code added for reminders
  if timer_onemin != nil then Wait.stop(timer_onemin) end
  if timer_tensec != nil then Wait.stop(timer_tensec) end
  if timer_all != nil then Wait.stop(timer_all) end
  if time > 60 then timer_onemin = Wait.time(|| broadcastToAll("你还有1分钟时间思考 One minute left", "Green"), time - 60) end
  if time > 10 then timer_tensec = Wait.time(|| broadcastToAll("只剩10秒了，赶紧的！Ten seconds left", "Orange"), time - 10) end
  timer_all = Wait.time(|| broadcastToAll("时间到！抬走！下一位！", "Red"), time)
end

function dec10(ob, pl)
    		if not Player[pl].admin then
        			return 1
    		end

    if time > 11 then
        time = time - 10
        local b = self.getButtons()
        b[1].label = math.floor(time/60)..':'..string.format('%02d', time%60)
        self.editButton(b[1])
    end
end

function dec1(ob, pl)
    		if not Player[pl].admin then
        			return 1
    		end

    if time > 1 then
        time = time - 1
        local b = self.getButtons()
        b[1].label = math.floor(time/60)..':'..string.format('%02d', time%60)
        self.editButton(b[1])
    end
end

function inc1(ob, pl)
    		if not Player[pl].admin then
        			return 1
    		end

    time = time + 1
    local b = self.getButtons()
    b[1].label = math.floor(time/60)..':'..string.format('%02d', time%60)
    self.editButton(b[1])
end

function inc10(ob, pl)
    		if not Player[pl].admin then
        			return 1
    		end

    time = time + 10
    local b = self.getButtons()
    b[1].label = math.floor(time/60)..':'..string.format('%02d', time%60)
    self.editButton(b[1])
end

function doNothing()
end

-- Universal Counter Tokens      coded by: MrStump

--Saves the count value into a table (data_to_save) then encodes it into the Tabletop save
function onSave()
    local data_to_save = {saved_count = count}
    saved_data = JSON.encode(data_to_save)
    return saved_data
end

--Loads the saved data then creates the buttons
function onload(saved_data)
    generateButtonParamiters()
    --Checks if there is a saved data. If there is, it gets the saved value for 'count'
    if saved_data != '' then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        count = loaded_data.saved_count
    else
        --If there wasn't saved data, the default value is set to 10.
        count = 10
    end

    --Generates the buttons after putting the count value onto the 'display' button
    b_display.label = tostring(count)
    if count >= 100 then
        b_display.font_size = 360
    else
        b_display.font_size = 500
    end
    self.createButton(b_display)
    self.createButton(b_plus)
    self.createButton(b_minus)
    self.createButton(b_plus5)
    self.createButton(b_minus5)
end

--Activates when + is hit. Adds 1 to 'count' then updates the display button.
function increase()
    count = count + 1
    updateDisplay()
end

--Activates when - is hit. Subtracts 1 from 'count' then updates the display button.
function decrease()
    --Prevents count from going below 0
    if count > 0 then
        count = count - 1
        updateDisplay()
    end
end

--Activates when + is hit. Adds 5 to 'count' then updates the display button.
function increase5()
    count = count + 5
    updateDisplay()
end

--Activates when - is hit. Subtracts 5 from 'count' then updates the display button.
function decrease5()
    --Prevents count from going below 0
    if count > 4 then
        count = count - 5
    else
        count = 0
    end
    updateDisplay()
end

function customSet()
    local description = self.getDescription()
    if description != '' and type(tonumber(description)) == 'number' then
        self.setDescription('')
        count = tonumber(description)
        updateDisplay()
    end
end

--function that updates the display. I trigger it whenever I change 'count'
function updateDisplay()
    --If statement to resize font size if it gets too long
    if count >= 100 then
        b_display.font_size = 360
    else
        b_display.font_size = 500
    end
    b_display.label = tostring(count)
    self.editButton(b_display)
end

--This is activated when onload runs. This sets all paramiters for our buttons.
--I do not have to put this all into a function, but I prefer to do it this way.
function generateButtonParamiters()
    b_display = {
        index = 0, click_function = 'customSet', function_owner = self, label = '',
        position = {0,0.1,0}, width = 800, height = 600, font_size = 500
    }
    b_plus = {
        click_function = 'increase', function_owner = self, label =  '+1',
        position = {1.45,-0.1,0.6}, width = 600, height = 500, font_size = 500
    }
    b_minus = {
        click_function = 'decrease', function_owner = self, label =  '-1',
        position = {-1.45,-0.1,0.6}, width = 600, height = 500, font_size = 500
    }
    b_plus5 = {
        click_function = 'increase5', function_owner = self, label =  '+5',
        position = {1.45,-0.1,-0.6}, width = 600, height = 500, font_size = 500
    }
    b_minus5 = {
        click_function = 'decrease5', function_owner = self, label =  '-5',
        position = {-1.45,-0.1,-0.6}, width = 600, height = 500, font_size = 500
    }
end

-- Spend Tracker (modified MrStump counter)
-- Syncs with money counter via Global script

function onSave()
    return JSON.encode({saved_count = count})
end

function onload(saved_data)
    generateButtonParamiters()
    if saved_data ~= '' then
        count = JSON.decode(saved_data).saved_count
    else
        count = 0
    end
    b_display.label = tostring(count)
    if count >= 100 then b_display.font_size = 360 else b_display.font_size = 500 end
    self.createButton(b_display)
    self.createButton(b_plus)
    self.createButton(b_minus)
    self.createButton(b_plus5)
    self.createButton(b_minus5)
end

function increase()
    count = count + 1
    updateDisplay()
    syncMoney()
end

function decrease()
    if count > 0 then count = count - 1 end
    updateDisplay()
    syncMoney()
end

function increase5()
    count = count + 5
    updateDisplay()
    syncMoney()
end

function decrease5()
    if count > 4 then count = count - 5 else count = 0 end
    updateDisplay()
    syncMoney()
end

function customSet()
    local desc = self.getDescription()
    if desc ~= '' and type(tonumber(desc)) == 'number' then
        self.setDescription('')
        count = tonumber(desc)
        updateDisplay()
        syncMoney()
    end
end

function syncMoney()
    -- Call Global function to sync money counter
    if Global and Global.call then
        Global.call('onSpendChanged', {guid = self.getGUID(), spent = count})
    end
end

function updateDisplay()
    if count >= 100 then b_display.font_size = 360 else b_display.font_size = 500 end
    b_display.label = tostring(count)
    self.editButton(b_display)
end

function generateButtonParamiters()
    b_display = {
        index = 0, click_function = 'customSet', function_owner = self, label = '',
        position = {0,0.1,0}, width = 800, height = 600, font_size = 500
    }
    b_plus = {
        click_function = 'increase', function_owner = self, label = '+1',
        position = {1.45,-0.1,0.6}, width = 600, height = 500, font_size = 500
    }
    b_minus = {
        click_function = 'decrease', function_owner = self, label = '-1',
        position = {-1.45,-0.1,0.6}, width = 600, height = 500, font_size = 500
    }
    b_plus5 = {
        click_function = 'increase5', function_owner = self, label = '+5',
        position = {1.45,-0.1,-0.6}, width = 600, height = 500, font_size = 500
    }
    b_minus5 = {
        click_function = 'decrease5', function_owner = self, label = '-5',
        position = {-1.45,-0.1,-0.6}, width = 600, height = 500, font_size = 500
    }

function onload()
    --按钮锁
    isButtonLocked = false
    --时代标记
    times = 1
    --按钮
    fourP_Button = getObjectFromGUID("3ba14f")
    threeP_Button = getObjectFromGUID("9c5d5e")
    towP_Button = getObjectFromGUID("5f8b97")
    --获得牌库
    deck = getObjectFromGUID("b6ff44")
    --市场板块
    market_zone = getObjectFromGUID("319330")
    --酒桶
    barrel = getObjectFromGUID("4be839")
    --吸附点
    point_pool = Global.getSnapPoints()

    --创建按钮
    local button = {}
    button.tooltip = "准备2人局"
    button.height = 800
    button.width = 800
    button.font_size = 50
    button.position = {0, 0.1, 0}
    button.rotation = {0, 0, 0}
    button.click_function = "on_Button_pressed"
    button.function_owner = self
    button.color = {1, 1, 1, 0}
    self.createButton(button)
end

function on_Button_pressed()
    if isButtonLocked == false then
        startLuaCoroutine(self, "prepareGame")
        isButtonLocked = true
        self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = "请稍等..."})
        broadcastToAll("开始设置2人游戏", "Yellow")
        startLuaCoroutine(threeP_Button, "LockButton")
        startLuaCoroutine(fourP_Button, "LockButton")
    end
end

function prepareGame()
    --运河时代洗混市场板块
    if times == 1 then
        market = getCardInZone(market_zone)
        market.shuffle()
    end
    deck.shuffle()
    delay(20)
    for _,point in pairs(point_pool) do
        --放置牌库
        if point.tags[1] == "Deck" then
            deck_pos = point.position
            deck_rot = point.rotation
            deck.setPositionSmooth(deck_pos)
            delay(5)
            deck.setRotationSmooth(deck_rot)
            delay(5)
        --放置市场
        elseif point.tags[3] == "M2" and times == 1 then
            putMarketToken(point)
        --放置酒桶
        elseif point.tags[3] == "B2" then
            putBarrelToken(point)
        end
    end
    
    broadcastToAll("设置完成！", "Green")
    if times == 1 then
        times = 2
        isButtonLocked = false
        self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = "准备2人铁路时代"})
    else
        self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = "重开一局吧"})
    end
    
    return 1
end

--放置市场板块
function putMarketToken(point)
    market = getCardInZone(market_zone)
    local params = {}
    params.position = point.position
    params.rotation = point.rotation
    params.smooth = true
    if market.type == "Deck" then
        market.takeObject(params)
        delay(10)
    elseif market.type == "Card" then
        market.setPositionSmooth(point.position)
        delay(5)
        market.setRotationSmooth(point.rotation)
        delay(5)
    end
end

--放置酒桶
function putBarrelToken(point)
    local params = {}
    params.position = point.position
    params.smooth = true
    barrel.takeObject(params)
    delay(10)
end

--获取市场板块
function getCardInZone(zone)
    for _,obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
        if obj.type == "Card" or obj.type == "Deck" then
            return obj
        end
    end
end

--锁定按钮
function LockButton()
    isButtonLocked = true
    return 1
end

--动作间隔
function delay(frame)
    for i = 1,frame do
        coroutine.yield(0)
    end
end

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
function onload()
    --按钮锁
    isButtonLocked = false
    --时代标记
    times = 1
    
    --AI行动按钮
    drawButton = getObjectFromGUID("b51777")
    
    --获取ABC三种牌堆区域
    zone_A = getObjectFromGUID("ed745e")
    zone_B = getObjectFromGUID("7e48f1")
    zone_C = getObjectFromGUID("ff5720")   

    --目标区域
    zone_draw = getObjectFromGUID("be2900")
    zone_target = getObjectFromGUID("aabc9a")

    --二时代牌库
    deck2_A = getObjectFromGUID("28b0a7")
    deck2_B = getObjectFromGUID("d99bab")
    deck2_C = getObjectFromGUID("bd41e2")
    
    --创建按钮
    local button = {}
    button.tooltip = "准备AI牌库"
    button.height = 800
    button.width = 800
    button.position = {0, 0.1, 0}
    button.click_function = "on_Button_pressed"
    button.function_owner = self
    button.color = {1, 1, 1, 0}
    self.createButton(button)
end

function on_Button_pressed()
    if isButtonLocked == false then
        startLuaCoroutine(self, "prepareMautoma")
        isButtonLocked = true
        broadcastToAll("AI开始准备！", "Yellow")
        startLuaCoroutine(drawButton, "LockButton")
        startLuaCoroutine(drawButton, "ResetCount")
        self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = "请稍等..."})
    end
end

function prepareMautoma()
    --清除上时代卡牌
    clearCardsInZone(zone_draw)
    clearCardsInZone(zone_target)
    delay(5)
    
    --获取三个牌堆
    deck_A = getDeckInZone(zone_A)
    deck_B = getDeckInZone(zone_B)
    deck_C = getDeckInZone(zone_C)
 
    --分别混洗三个牌堆
    deck_A.shuffle()
    deck_B.shuffle()
    deck_C.shuffle()
    delay(30)
    
    --目标牌库数据
    local params = {}
    params.position = zone_draw.getPosition()
    params.position[2] = 1
    params.flip = false
    params.top = true
    params.smooth = true

    --拿4张A类牌，3张B类牌，3张C类牌
    takeCard("A", 4, params)
    takeCard("B", 3, params)
    takeCard("C", 3, params)
    --洗混并转移
    shuffle_and_move()

    --ABC各抽一张混洗
    takeCard("A",1,params)
    takeCard("B",1,params)
    takeCard("C",1,params)
    --洗混并转移
    shuffle_and_move()

    --剩余牌混洗
    deck_A = getDeckInZone(zone_A)
    deck_C = getDeckInZone(zone_C)
    deck_A.setPositionSmooth(params.position)
    delay(5)
    deck_C.setPositionSmooth(params.position)
    delay(5)
    --洗混并转移
    shuffle_and_move()

    --翻转牌库
    delay(50)
    deck_mautoma = getDeckInZone(zone_target)
    deck_mautoma.flip()
    delay(20)
    
    --一时代完成
    if times == 1 then
        moveSecondDecks()
        broadcastToAll("AI准备就绪！", "Green")
        self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = "准备铁路时代"})
        isButtonLocked = false
        times = 2
    --二时代完成
    else
        broadcastToAll("AI准备就绪！", "Green")
        self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = "重开一局吧"})
        isButtonLocked = true
    end
    startLuaCoroutine(drawButton, "unLockButton")

    return 1
end

--清除上时代卡牌
function clearCardsInZone(zone)
    for _,obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
        if not obj.hasTag("Back") then
            destroyObject(obj)
        end
    end
end

--移动二时代牌库
function moveSecondDecks()
    params2A = zone_A.getPosition()
    params2A[2] = 1
    deck2_A.setPositionSmooth(params2A)
    delay(5)
    params2B = zone_B.getPosition()
    params2B[2] = 1
    deck2_B.setPositionSmooth(params2B)
    delay(5)
    params2C = zone_C.getPosition()
    params2C[2] = 1
    deck2_C.setPositionSmooth(params2C)
    delay(5)
end

--混洗并转移
function shuffle_and_move()
    --等待牌库构成
    delay(100)
    --获取临时牌库
    deck_temp = getDeckInZone(zone_draw)
    --混洗临时牌库
    deck_temp.shuffle()
    delay(30)
    --转移位置
    local target_position = zone_target.getPosition()
    target_position[2] = 1.5
    deck_temp.setPositionSmooth(target_position)
    delay(50)
end

--拿牌
function takeCard(index, count, params)
    --获取对应牌堆
    if index == "A" then
        deck = getCardsInZone(zone_A)
    elseif index == "B" then
        deck = getCardsInZone(zone_B)
    elseif index == "C" then
        deck = getCardsInZone(zone_C)
    end
    
    --是牌堆就拿牌，是卡牌就移动
    if deck.type == "Deck" then
        for i=1,count do
            deck.takeObject(params)
            delay(5)
        end
    elseif deck.type == "Card" then
        deck.setPositionSmooth(params.position)

function onload()
    DECKCOUNT = 22
    --抽牌数量
    drawCount = 0
    --按钮锁
    isButtonLocked = true

    --牌库区和抽牌区
    zone_deck = getObjectFromGUID("aabc9a")
    zone_draw = getObjectFromGUID("be2900")
    
    --目标牌库数据
    params = {}
    params.position = zone_draw.getPosition()
    params.position[2] = 2
    params.flip = true
    params.top = true
    params.smooth = true
    
    --创建按钮
    local button = {}
    button.tooltip = "AI行动"
    button.height = 800
    button.width = 800
    button.font_size = 50
    button.position = {0, -0.1, 0}
    button.rotation = {180, 0, 0}
    button.click_function = "on_Button_pressed"
    button.function_owner = self
    button.color = {1, 1, 1, 0}
    self.createButton(button)
end

function on_Button_pressed()
    if isButtonLocked == false then
        startLuaCoroutine(self, "mautomaDrawCard")
    else
        printToAll("AI还未准备好...")
        broadcastToAll("请先准备AI牌库", "Red")
    end
end

--AI抽牌
function mautomaDrawCard()
    if drawCount >= DECKCOUNT then
        broadcastToAll("AI牌库已经用完", "Red")
    else
        takeCard(params)
        drawCount = drawCount+1
        broadcastToAll("AI抽牌", "Green")
    end

    return 1
end

--解锁按钮
function unLockButton()
    isButtonLocked = false
    return 1
end

--锁定按钮
function LockButton()
    isButtonLocked = true
    return 1
end

--重置计数
function ResetCount()
    drawCount = 0
    return 1
end

--获取卡牌堆
function getCardsInZone(zone)
    for _,obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
        if not obj.hasTag("Back") and obj.type == "Card" or obj.type == "Deck" then
            return obj
        end
    end
end

--抽牌牌
function takeCard(params)
    --获取AI牌堆
    deck = getCardsInZone(zone_deck)
    
    --是牌堆就拿牌，是卡牌就移动
    if deck.type == "Deck" then
        deck.takeObject(params)
        delay(5)
    elseif deck.type == "Card" then
        deck.flip()
        delay(5)
        deck.setPositionSmooth(params.position)
        delay(5)
    end
end

--动作间隔
function delay(frame)
    for i = 1,frame do
        coroutine.yield(0)
    end
end
